method: First-pass catalog of major negative national and Maine-outlet stories about Graham Platner from campaign launch (Aug 2025) through withdrawal (formal, Jul 10, 2026). Neutral summaries: allegations recorded as allegations, denials as denials; no judgment about the truth of any allegation or the motive of any journalist or outlet. 'Attack' in the dataset name describes the subject's characterization and the stories' negative valence, not a finding of intent. Some URLs/bylines pending verification — see fields marked null.

records.headline: 'I got older and became a communist': Deleted posts show Maine Senate hopeful's raw views on politics, war, and police
records.summary: Deleted Reddit posts (mostly 2013–2021, handle 'P-Hustle') in which Platner called himself 'a communist,' said all police are 'bastards,' and said rural white Americans 'actually are' racist and unintelligent.

records.headline: Maine Senate candidate promoted violent political action in since-deleted online posts
records.summary: 2018 Reddit posts in which Platner wrote to 'fight with signs, and fists, and guns if need be' and that 'an armed working class is a requirement for economic justice.'

records.headline: Maine Senate candidate downplayed sexual assault concerns in deleted posts
records.summary: Additional recovered posts, including a 2013 comment that people should 'take some responsibility for themselves' and avoid heavy intoxication to avoid being raped, and dismissive comments about sexual assault in the military.

records.outlet: Bangor Daily News / The Maine Monitor
records.headline: Graham Platner asked why Black people 'don't tip' and referenced rape in old Reddit posts
records.summary: Additional recovered posts: a 2013 'why don't black people tip' question and the sexual-assault-responsibility comment.

records.summary: Maine-outlet synthesis of the CNN and Politico reporting and in-state reaction.

records.headline: Graham Platner says 'I am not a secret Nazi' after photos of his tattoo emerge
records.summary: Chest tattoo resembling the SS Totenkopf; a former acquaintance said Platner called it 'my Totenkopf' at a Capitol Hill bar around 2012.

records.headline: Senate hopeful Platner changed tattoo ex-aide calls anti-Semitic
records.summary: Former political director Genevieve McDonald said Platner/campaign knew the tattoo was a problem weeks before it became public (BDN ran a parallel story the same day).

records.headline: Platner says he was drunk when he got Nazi-linked tattoo
records.summary: Platner's account of the tattoo's origin and his plan to remove or cover it; Sanders stood by him.

records.summary: An October 2020 Reddit post in which Platner noted an 'antifa supersoldier' label on his 'armor.'

records.headline: Senate candidate Graham Platner reveals new tattoo covering up one that resembled a Nazi symbol
records.summary: Platner revealed he had covered the tattoo with a new design (Celtic knot).

records.headline: 'Working Class' Graham Platner Attended Elite $75K a Year Prep School Known for Famous Government Alumni
records.summary: Reported Platner attended the Hotchkiss School, contrasting with his working-class self-presentation; a late-Oct follow-up ran in the same vein.

records.headline: Graham Platner's claims that he didn't know tattoo was Nazi-linked undercut by new evidence
records.summary: Deleted posts (2019 Totenkopf thread; 2020 comment on SS lightning-bolt tattoos) and an acquaintance interview presented as undercutting Platner's account that he only recently learned the tattoo's association.

records.summary: A surfaced recording characterized as showing preoccupation with Israel/Gaza-war topics.

records.headline: Platner boosted an antisemitic conspiracy theorist online

records.headline: Platner sat for lengthy interview with antisemitic conspiracy theorist, said he was 'longtime fan' of his show
records.summary: A lengthy Platner interview with podcaster Nate Cornacchia, whom JI described as an antisemitic conspiracy theorist.

records.headline: Ad attacking Graham Platner draws on 2013 Reddit comment
records.summary: Fact-check of a Pine Tree Results PAC attack ad using Platner's 2013 Reddit comment about rape victims — documents the paid-media use of the earlier reporting.

records.headline: Graham Platner's Wife Flagged Sexually-Explicit Texts to His Senate Campaign
records.summary: Reported that Amy Gertner alerted campaign aides in late Aug 2025 — during internal opposition research — to sexually explicit texts Platner exchanged with multiple women.

records.headline: Platner's Texts With Women Concerned Campaign as Senate Race Took Off
records.summary: Same-day report: Gertner told a former campaign official Platner had exchanged sexual messages with as many as a dozen women (a current official put it at up to six). Campaign later acknowledged the texts were real.

records.headline: Top Graham Platner adviser threatened former aide over sexting stories
records.summary: Strategist Morris Katz, via an intermediary, warned Genevieve McDonald she would be accused of lying and sabotage if she cooperated with outlets; BDN reviewed the message.

records.headline: Several Women Who Dated Graham Platner Recall 'Unsettling' Behavior
records.summary: Interviews with six former partners; three described volatile relationships. Fifield alleged grabbing and restraint; the Times stated it could not independently corroborate the altercations.
records.note: Fifield later publicly accused the Times of twisting her story ('a gift to the Platner campaign').

records.headline: Graham Platner can't explain why ex-girlfriend knew tattoo's Nazi-link before he says he did
records.summary: Fifield — previously CNN's anonymous source — went public, saying Platner had years earlier called the tattoo 'my Totenkopf.'

records.headline: Timeline of Graham Platner controversies in Maine Senate race

records.headline: Graham Platner once mocked teen's suicide attempt in Reddit posts
records.summary: A May 2012 Reddit reply from the P-Hustle account under a thread about a teen's suicide attempt: 'Someone clearly isn't trying hard enough.'

records.headline: Conservatives rip Platner for 'disturbing' online trail as new Reddit post mocking teen suicide surfaces

records.headline: Exclusive: Woman who dated Graham Platner says he sexually assaulted her
records.summary: Jenny Racicot alleged that in late 2021 Platner entered her home uninvited while deeply intoxicated and forced himself on her as she repeatedly told him to stop.
records.note: Platner: 'Any accusation of non-consensual behavior is categorically untrue.' See the verification ledger for the evidence items and their provenance.
